source_supported_proposition: The index records approval of an EdSights procurement exemption on 6 May 2025, estimated at USD 2 million for five years.
inference_boundary: An exemption approval is not an independent technical or safeguard assessment.

source_supported_proposition: The procurement rationale assigns fiscal, project-management and IT oversight responsibilities.
inference_boundary: Named procurement responsibilities do not establish all operational privacy, equity or student-redress controls.

source_supported_proposition: The university announces a five-year USD 1.8 million contract and rollout across its campuses.
inference_boundary: This announced contract value differs in role from the earlier USD 2 million estimate; neither is a measured student benefit.

source_supported_proposition: The campus minutes record 218 students flagged for follow-up.
inference_boundary: A flag count is not a count of completed interventions or demonstrated improvements in persistence.

source_supported_proposition: The minutes explain the displayed 95 percent participation wording as the complement of approximately 5 percent opting out.
inference_boundary: The complement of an opt-out share does not by itself measure affirmative informed opt-in; no legal conclusion is made.

source_supported_proposition: Discussion records an opt-out instruction and a no-penalty statement, while identifying a need for clearer communication.
inference_boundary: This documents the discussion, not verification that every student received complete information or that all concerns were resolved.

source_supported_proposition: The published security approval permits procurement without another review only within stated data-use and expiry conditions.
inference_boundary: A tool approved for nonsensitive data is not thereby approved for sensitive student records.

source_supported_proposition: The institutional list gives conditional permission to purchase the listed applications.
inference_boundary: Permission to purchase does not establish an actual contract, deployment or institutional benefit.

source_supported_proposition: The university notice concerns discontinuation of the AI-detection function.
inference_boundary: This document does not establish termination of every Turnitin service or a researcher-replicated performance evaluation.

source_supported_proposition: An institutional library guide reports that AI writing detection is disabled in similarity reports.
inference_boundary: This is library guidance about a feature, not a signed governing-body decision or an independently observed configuration audit.

source_supported_proposition: The university announces nonrenewal of its entire Turnitin contract beyond the 2026/27 academic year and a phased withdrawal.
inference_boundary: A future whole-contract nonrenewal differs from immediate shutdown of one feature.

source_supported_proposition: The procurement rationale cites a 2023 trial in support of a risk-prediction statement without identifying a reproducible study protocol.
inference_boundary: Do not treat the separately retrieved SNHU intervention report as that exact predictive-validation study merely because the vendor is the same.

source_supported_proposition: The partner report gives 3327 students per arm and displayed persistence rates of 75.9 and 77.3 percent.
inference_boundary: The displayed difference is 1.4 percentage points, not a verified covariate-adjusted treatment effect.

source_supported_proposition: The report describes persistence and GPA-above-2 differences as statistically significant.
inference_boundary: A transparent unadjusted check of the displayed rates and denominators does not reproduce that inference; the original statistical method is not supplied in the report.

source_supported_proposition: The reported study concerns SNHU first-time first-year online undergraduate students.
inference_boundary: A reported effect at SNHU is not evidence of the corresponding effect in Hawaii without a justified transport analysis.

source_supported_proposition: The procurement rationale describes forwarding time-sensitive messages to designated staff and supplying resources.
inference_boundary: A described forwarding workflow is not an independent audit of response timeliness, missed cases or effectiveness.
